summary: The Archive screen (portale.html markup 2186-2232) is a paginated table of "intelligence captures": date, type, item title + crop/region subtitle, source, and a "CONNECTED TO" column, plus a text query, four dropdown filters (type / crop / region / company), nine coloured type chips with counts, and a right-hand drawer with a summary paragraph, crop/issue/region tags and up to six cross-links (opportunity, future signal, ADAMA product, competitor, source, research topic). Today every fact on that screen comes from window.ITALY_DEMO.ARCHIVE: 448 rows, of which 420 are procedurally generated in italy-demo-data.js lines 522-538 (type, source route, company, product, caseObj, signal and an English prose summary are all synthesised from a modulo over the demo CASES/SIGNALS arrays) and only 28 are real (news + bulletins + science re-shaped at lines 539-543). The screen also feeds the nav badge (line 2608, K.archive = 448), the Data-State panel Archive row (line 2530), the Source-detail "LATEST CAPTURES · N IN ARCHIVE" block (line 3368, markup 2311-2312) and the global search ARCHIVE group (line 3383). The real replacement, APP.collections.archive, already exists and holds 740 rows derived from the normalized collections, but it is currently dead code — declared as A_ARCHIVE0 at line 2467 and never read.

modelChanges.derivation: SCIENCE date: line 269 passes r.date||r.year, but scienceRecords maps date from r.DATE||r.date and IG.SCIENCE has neither — the real field is PUBLISHED_AT (measured 88/88 non-null, e.g. '2024-04-01'). Result today: 88/88 SCIENCE rows have date null. Fix scienceRecords to read S(r.PUBLISHED_AT). — EVENT title: line 273 passes e.name, mapped from e.NAME||e.name; IG.EVENTS field is EVENT (measured 18/18 non-null, e.g. 'EIMA International 2026'). Result today: 18/18 EVENT rows have title null. — EVENT url: mapped from e.URL||e.url; the real field is OFFICIAL_URL (18/18). Also line 273 passes e.location as the SOURCE column, so the source reads 'BolognaFiere, Bologna' / 'Piemonte'; use ORGANIZER (5 distinct, 18/18) as source and keep LOCATION as a separate location field. — NEWS source: line 274 passes n.outlet, mapped from n.OUTLET||n.outlet||n.SOURCE; the real field is PUBLISHER (8/8). Result today: 8/8 NEWS rows show a blank SOURCE cell. — NEWS url: mapped from n.URL||n.url; the real field is SOURCE_URL (8/8). — MARKET crop: line 270 passes m.product as the crop. IG.MARKET.PRODUCT is a price-series code ('BLTPAN|PAN', 'MAI|FEED', 'DUR|UNKNOWN', 'Extra virgin olive oil (up to 0.8%)'), not a crop. It injects 12 non-crop values into the crop filter over 77 rows. Set crop = null and expose the code as archive.series instead. — COMPETITOR crop: line 271 passes (a.crops||[])[0]; measured values include the generic Italian words 'colture' (29 rows), 'cereali' (19), 'frutta' (3) alongside Latin binomials. Keep them but tag the vocabulary (see next entry) so the filter does not present them as crop keys.

Every one of those facts today comes from window.ITALY_DEMO: D.SOURCES (53 hand-written entries with cov/topics/what/freq/health/lastDays/related), D.EVENTS (6 entries with city/region/dates/startDays/crops/exhibitorStatus/program/participation for BASF, Bayer, Corteva, FMC, Syngenta, UPL) and D.NEWS (= window.ITALY_REAL.NEWS, 9 hand-curated Sep-2026 items with days/use/editorial/originating). The real backing is window.ITALY_INGEST: SOURCES[31], EVENTS[18], NEWS[8], CHANNELS[30] — a different, smaller and differently-shaped reality that the app model already normalizes, but with four field-name bugs that make the real data arrive as null.
realSource: window.ITALY_APP_MODEL.collections.sources (31, from IG.SOURCES), .events (18, from IG.EVENTS), .news (8, from IG.NEWS), .channels (30, from IG.CHANNELS). Cross-links: IG.OPPORTUNITIES[3].SOURCE_IDS and IG.FUTURE_SIGNALS[3].SOURCE_IDS are the ONLY records that name their sources (ITALY_CANONICAL.windows carry SOURCE_IDS on 0/29). Per-source backing volume is derivable from SOURCE_ID on SCIENCE/MARKET/VOICES/RESISTANCE/THEMES/CROP_WINDOWS/RESEARCHERS.
